variants.specifics: Garrick at the north gate, shut by Reeve Halvard because Red Corwin's bandits rob the north road; see the Reeve.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Halt, stranger! The north gate is shut by the Reeve's order. Red Corwin's bandits rob the north road! See Reeve Halvard in the Moot Hall.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: The gate stays shut! Go and see the Reeve.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Red Corwin is dead! The Reeve has opened the north gate. Pass, friend -- and watch the road!

variants.specifics: Tobin guards the ford, closed to the east bank because the Urchins of the old barrow rob travellers; see Reeve Halvard; later the Urchins are gone.

first.speaker: Tobin
first.text: Stop right there! Nobody crosses the ford to the east. The Urchins from the old barrow rob anyone who tries! Ask Reeve Halvard at the Moot Hall.

later.speaker: Tobin
later.text: The Urchins are gone from the barrow! The ford is open again. Go on across, friend!

variants.specifics: Edric at the west gate, barred because the Ashwood wolves raid the folds; see Ulric the shepherd; later Greyjaw is dead.

first.speaker: Edric
first.text: Halt! The west gate stays barred. Wolves came down out of the Ashwood -- three sheep gone this week! Talk to Ulric the shepherd about it.

again.speaker: Edric
again.text: Hear that howling? The gate stays barred!

later.speaker: Edric
later.text: Greyjaw is dead, they say! The west gate is open. Good hunting, stranger!

variants.specifics: Cobb at the Moot Hall door, letting no strangers in for fear of Corwin's spies; see Ossian at the Drowned Lantern to vouch; later Corwin is dead.

first.speaker: Cobb
first.text: No further, stranger! The Reeve sees nobody he doesn't know. Corwin has spies in town! Get Ossian at the Drowned Lantern to speak for you.

again.speaker: Cobb
again.text: No word from Ossian, no way in!

later.speaker: Cobb
later.text: Corwin's dead and his spies are fled! The Reeve will see anyone now. Go on in!

variants.specifics: Rook at the ferry landing on the Bracken, the ferry tied up because Corwin's men wait on the far bank; see the Reeve; later the ferry runs.

first.speaker: Rook
first.text: Sorry, friend, the ferry's tied up! Corwin's men wait on the far bank of the Bracken. The Reeve stopped all crossings. See him at the Moot Hall.

again.speaker: Rook
again.text: No ferry today! Or tomorrow, likely.

later.speaker: Rook
later.text: Corwin's men are gone from the far bank! The ferry runs again. Hop aboard, friend!

variants.specifics: Marten at the foot of the Crow Hill path, keeping folk from Corwin's archers; the Reeve's leave needed; later the hill is free.

first.speaker: Marten
first.text: Turn back! This path climbs Crow Hill, right under Corwin's watchtower. His archers shoot anything that moves! Nobody goes up without the Reeve's leave.

again.speaker: Marten
again.text: Up there? Not without the Reeve's say-so!

later.speaker: Marten
later.text: Red Corwin is dead! Crow Hill belongs to Brackenford again. The path is yours, stranger!

variants.specifics: Aldous guards the town granary, rationed since no carts come down the north road; sends the player to the Drowned Lantern for food; later the carts return.

first.speaker: Aldous
first.text: Keep back from the granary! No carts come down the north road now. Every sack is counted by the Reeve's order. Hungry? Try the Drowned Lantern.

later.speaker: Aldous
later.text: The carts are rolling in again! The Reeve says the granary's open. Bread for everyone!

variants.specifics: Bess at the river gate, chained shut since Corwin's bandits stole boats; Captain Thorne at the Moot Hall has the key; later the boats are back.

first.speaker: Bess
first.text: Hold there! The river gate is chained shut. Corwin's bandits stole two boats last week! Captain Thorne has the key, and he's at the Moot Hall.

later.speaker: Bess
later.text: Corwin's dead and the boats are back! The river gate is open, stranger. Off you go!

variants.specifics: Fenn at the door of the Chapel of the Ford, locked since the Urchins stole the candlesticks; see Brother Anselm; later the candlesticks are back.

first.speaker: Fenn
first.text: The chapel is shut, stranger! The Urchins stole the candlesticks off the altar! Brother Anselm keeps the door locked now. Knock at his house behind the chapel.

again.speaker: Fenn
again.text: Locked! Go and see Brother Anselm.

later.speaker: Fenn
later.text: The candlesticks are back on the altar! The chapel is open again. Come in and give thanks!

variants.specifics: Jory, a jumpy young watchman at the south gate, locked after dark because wolves prowl the walls; sends the player to Ossian for a bed; later Greyjaw is dead.

first.speaker: Jory
first.text: Ah! You gave me a fright! The south gate's locked after dark. Wolves prowl the walls! Get a bed from Ossian at the Drowned Lantern.

again.speaker: Jory
again.text: Hmmm. Did you hear something? Go on, get inside!

later.speaker: Jory
later.text: Greyjaw's dead, so the gate stays open all night now! I can finally stop jumping at shadows.
